title: Yielding Australian Beef Broth
description: A warm, malt-infused beef broth that balances richness with a subtle lightness, perfect for spooning over roasted vegetables or serving as a comforting base for soups.
instructions: In a large stockpot, bring the beef stock to a gentle simmer over medium heat.
Add the diced onion, sliced carrots, sliced celery, and minced garlic, stirring to combine.
Stir in the cooked malted barley, bay leaf, dried thyme, Worcestershire sauce, and sea salt.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste the broth and season with freshly ground black pepper to your preference.
Remove the bay leaf and discard the solids by straining the broth through a fine-mesh sieve.
Return the clear broth to the pot and bring it back to a light simmer.
Ladle the hot broth over steamed vegetables, roasted root veggies, or use it as a soup base.
For an extra indulgent flavor, garnish with a drizzle of high-quality beef stock before serving.
Allow the broth to cool slightly and enjoy with crusty bread for a complete meal.
